prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1444; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in the sideswipe collision that occurred while your insured was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client has retained counsel, and any inquiry concerning the claim should come through us.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or dash camera footage, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any communications with your insured or other parties. Please suspend any routine destruction of records until this matter is fully resolved.

Please confirm receipt of this letter and provide your written response within fourteen days.
